name: Over resource limits
desc: Nonterminating execution and output allocations exceeding practical configured limits. Run with finite work, memory, and applicable nesting limits, plus an external watchdog. Only RESOURCE_LIMIT is an expected engine outcome; host exceptions, process termination, watchdog expiry, NO_MATCH, and successful completion are failures. The large ROUND cases request at least 100 trillion output characters and require a configured allocation budget below that amount. All structures are valid; these are not malformed-graft or catastrophic-backtracking tests.

tests.name: Unbounded execution
tests.desc: These grafts have no successful terminating execution. Even loops with no net data growth must consume a finite processing budget.

tests.name: Repeated constant assignment
tests.desc: A true WHILE condition never changes. Repeatedly overwriting the root with 1 does not require growing memory, so execution accounting must still stop it.

tests.name: Recursive action macro
tests.desc: The ACT body calls its own constant binding indefinitely. Construction is finite; invocation must be limited even if calls are implemented without growing the host stack.

tests.name: Recursive value macro
tests.desc: The VAL body expands its own constant binding indefinitely. Resource checks must cover expression expansion as well as actions.

tests.name: Unbounded data growth
tests.desc: Infinite loops grow different representations. Implementations may hit work, memory, object, or nesting budgets first; every such outcome must be RESOURCE_LIMIT.

tests.name: Repeated string doubling
tests.desc: Each iteration doubles the root string. Account for native string allocation before allowing host memory exhaustion.

tests.name: Repeated array doubling
tests.desc: Each iteration doubles the logical array length. Sharing element storage must not bypass limits indefinitely.

tests.name: Repeated tree wrapping
tests.desc: Each iteration creates a new object containing the previous root. Account for work and object growth even if the previous subtree is shared.

tests.name: Unavoidable decimal output
tests.desc: Unlike the compact ROUND cases in 90-under-resource-limit.json, the final STR representation itself must contain at least 100 trillion characters. All exponent arithmetic stays within portable integer precision.

tests.name: Huge integer digit string
tests.desc: STR forbids scientific notation. The required result has 100000000000001 characters; reject against the configured output allocation budget before constructing it.

tests.name: Huge fractional padding
tests.desc: STR requires exactly at digits after the decimal point, even for zero. The required result has 100000000000002 characters.

tests.name: Allocation failure inside a match remains fatal
tests.desc: The ROUND expression is evaluated as the alternate target of IS. RESOURCE_LIMIT must escape match error trapping rather than becoming a false match and NO_MATCH.
